A0179.title: IoT Hardware Security Module
A0179.description: Integrate a Trusted Execution Environment (TEE) or a secure element (SE/TPM) into IoT devices to isolate keys, certificates, and sensitive computations within a hardware root of trust, defending against hardware attacks such as firmware extraction, side-channel analysis, and physical probing, thereby preventing device keys from being read or cloned.

references.title: GlobalPlatform TEE Internal Core API Specification v1.4

A0179.definition: Integrate Trusted Execution Environment (TEE) or security chips in IoT devices to defend against hardware attacks.
A0179.limitation: Increases BOM cost, making adoption difficult in low-cost IoT devices; TEEs themselves may contain vulnerabilities (e.g., speculative execution, cache side-channel) that can be exploited to break isolation and read keys; physical attacks such as fault injection, voltage glitching, and laser injection can compromise secure chip protections; once hardware is in mass production, it is difficult to upgrade, and discovered vulnerabilities cannot be fixed via software patches, leaving the security module at long-term risk of being cracked.
